build_unet_model: build a UNetModel with configurable channels, attention resolutions, and residual blocks for image generation
create_resblock: create a ResBlock with optional upsampling, downsampling, and scale shift normalization for feature processing
build_attention_block: build an AttentionBlock with configurable heads and QKV attention for spatial self-attention
create_timestep_embedding: create a TimestepEmbedSequential module that passes timestep embeddings through nested layers
generate_fourier_features: generate base-2 Fourier features from input tensors using configurable frequency ranges
